:::{#def-lik-obs}
#### Likelihood of a single observation

Let $X$ be a random variable, with observed value $x$,
and let $\p_{\Th}(X = x)$ be a probability model for the distribution of $X$,
with parameter vector $\Th$.
The **likelihood** of the parameter value $\param$,
for model $\p_{\Th}(X = x)$ and data $X = x$,
is the probability of the event $X = x$ when $\Th = \param$:

$$\Lik(\param) \eqdef \p_{\param}(X = x)$$

For a continuous random variable,
the likelihood is the probability density of $X$ at $x$ instead.
:::
